title: Build shell-free subprocess requests from constrained templates
instruction: Complete build_request(template, values, base_env) as a pure shell-free request builder. All inputs must be mappings with exact documented shapes. template has exact keys argv and optional env/cwd; argv is a non-empty list of strings whose first item is a fixed executable without placeholders. Placeholders use exactly {identifier}, must occupy an entire argv item or entire env value, and each declared values key must be used exactly once across argv and env. Reject conversions, format specifications, attribute/index access, mixed literal/placeholder strings, braces, NUL/control characters, and missing or extra values. Render to an argv list only, never a shell string. env names must match [A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*; start from a defensive copy of base_env and reject template attempts to overwrite inherited keys. cwd, if present, is a fixed non-empty relative POSIX path without placeholders, dot/parent segments, backslashes, or NUL. Return exactly argv, env, cwd and do not mutate inputs. Add tests and no dependencies.

author_metadata.notes: Wave-3 injection lineage with constrained placeholders, environment isolation, and shell-free argv semantics.
